usedFor: Pipedrive holds your people, and Reply gets them as outreach targets when “New Person Created” runs “Create Person”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Person Created” in Pipedrive, then “Create Person” in Reply
bestTemplate.why: A person added to Pipedrive appears in Reply, ready to be placed in a campaign.

watchOut: “New Person Created” is polling, so “Create Person” runs after a scheduled check, not at once.
